items.why: The commanding officer (CO) counsels you and records your Reserve commission choice before submission. Reserve appointment approval requires at least 4 months from Headquarters Marine Corps (HQMC) receipt of that request, after resignation approval and end of active service entry permit Reserve Affairs (RA) submission.

Explain whether you want a Reserve commission and confirm the required service-record entry.
Ask your personnel office and the officer separation desk to confirm routing and the applicable submission window.

Reserve appointments for officers transitioning from the AC to the RC require a minimum of four months from the date received at Headquarters Marine Corps (HQMC) for approval. In cases where the officer was subject to adversity this timeline is increased.
Once the resignation has been approved and an EAS is populated in the resigning officer's record, CMC(RA) will submit for a Reserve commission via the Secretary of Defense.
